## Release — backlog-campaign v0.31.0

### ✨ What's new in v0.31.0

#### Hook guard hardening

- Campaign workers can write to the campaign state directory again. The guard trusts it through a write-shape allow-list rather than a blanket path allowance, so only the expected write shapes pass ([#1280](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1280), [#1346](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1346)).
- One `trustedWriteRoots` helper now feeds both write guards. It covers the session scratchpad, and cross-repo campaign worktrees resolved from the user's HOME settings and the harness project settings ([#1296](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1296), [#1349](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1349)).
- `GIT_TRACE` guard (#1246): quoted, appended, escaped, ANSI-C and locale-quoted assignments are read the way the shell reads them. Glob, brace and expanding values are classified as opaque. Every operand of a declarer is scanned, and `env` (including `-S` strings, `-C` and option values) is read fail-closed.
- Command substitutions are scanned, including one opened through a backslash-newline before its paren (#1252).
- Any `env` operand containing `=` is treated as an assignment (#1295).
- Interpreters that read their script from stdin are inspected, including a script piped after a newline or redirected before the command (#1253).
- Quote masking is decided once for the whole command and applies only when every clause is a passive filter (#1249). Quoted command names match only where a command actually runs.

#### Merge gate and merge risk

- The `deletes-data` keyword scan is scoped, so it no longer fires on unrelated text (#1343, [#1345](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1345)).
- Slugged `blackhole/issue-N-<slug>` branches are recognised as campaign branches.
- The release-cadence scripts are classified as `release-tag`.
- `documentation/INDEX.md`, when regenerated, is exempt from the V-STACK-02 overlap check.

#### Peer campaigns

- A live peer campaign is detected at bootstrap (ADR-057), and forge-sync holds that peer's claimed issues out of the ready set.
- A mutual peer hold is now tie-broken, and heartbeat write errors are reported instead of swallowed ([#1335](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1335), [#1340](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1340)).

#### Status and dashboard

- The status page gains a Doc carry row (artifacts promised, staged and carried), and one shared scope label that the HTML page and `--data` both print.
- Completed and Issues filed are capped newest-first, and the dashboard type and spacing are more compact ([#1288](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1288)).

#### Catchup, usage and launch gate

- The catchup pace floor is linear over all 168 hours, with a `weekly_target_pct` setting.
- `usage-probe` maps `get_usage` plan limits into the rate-limit cache.
- The launch gate says "No usage limit" where it applies and asks for usage caps on the Budget card.

#### Carry and implementer

- A route-artifact gate for plan and design artifacts (V-AUTO-03, [#1301](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1301)); any non-zero `route-artifacts` exit blocks the implementer spawn.
- The implementer always builds and commits regenerated output before verify.

#### Release automation

- Release cadence: a workflow cuts a GitHub release every 20 merged PRs ([#1326](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1326), [#1331](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1331)). It is off until the owner sets `RELEASE_CADENCE_ENABLED`; see `documentation/runbooks/release-cadence.md`.
- `MANIFEST_PATHS` is derived from a single `VERSIONED_MANIFESTS` registry, and the release-notes gate and skill point at existing paths.

#### Other fixes

- Gitea forge calls use `tea --output json` and REST create ([#1292](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1292)).
- The SessionStart hook exports `BLACKHOLE_PLUGIN_ROOT` with a POSIX writer.
- Playbooks invoke `status` and `doctor` by script path rather than package.json aliases.

### Upgrade

The plugin cache is version-keyed, so the new hooks stay inert until you refresh it. Run `/plugin marketplace update`, then reinstall the plugin, and restart Claude Code.

### Known gaps

- [#1347](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1347): unmodelled Bash writers and a dangling-symlink Write leaf can still reach protected state-dir paths.
- [#1350](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1350): the Bash write guard is inactive when the agent's cwd is the main clone.
- [#1352](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1352): a worker-forged main clone can let its `config.json` `scratchpad_dir` grant write roots.
- [#1353](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1353): settings files, not the harness project dir, should be judged against writable roots.
